quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: You must yield for emergency vehicles:

options.text: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.
questions.explanation: You must give the right-of-way to emergency vehicles using sirens or flashing lights.

questions.question: Driving while distracted:

options.text: Usually slows your reaction time to hazards.
Is only dangerous for young drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Usually slows your reaction time to hazards.
questions.explanation: Distractions slow your ability to react to traffic and road hazards. Distracted driving is never safe.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass.

questions.question: As you near an intersection, the traffic light changes from green to yellow. Your best action is to:

options.text: Speed up to beat the red light.
Apply the brakes hard to stop.
Be ready to stop in the center of the intersection.
Be ready to stop before the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop before the intersection.
questions.explanation: Yellow means the light will soon turn red. Be prepared to stop before entering the intersection if it is safe.

questions.question: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle, you must:

options.text: Slow down until it passes you.
Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
Wave to let the emergency vehicle pass.
Merge into the right lane and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: Give the right-of-way to emergency vehicles using flashing lights or sirens. Move to the right side of the road and stop. If you are in an intersection, pass through it first before stopping on the right side.

questions.question: On long trips, you can prevent drowsiness by:

options.text: Moving your eyes side to side as you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stopping regularly to rest.
questions.explanation: Take regular breaks on long trips to rest and stretch, even if you do not feel tired.

questions.question: You are coming to a railroad crossing where the signals are flashing. You should:

options.text: Stop and look for a train.
Slow down and look for a train.
Look for a train, then speed up.
Do what the vehicle ahead of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and look for a train.
questions.explanation: At a flashing railroad crossing signal, you must stop at least 15 feet from the nearest rail. Watch for lowered gates or sounds of an oncoming train.

questions.question: A red arrow on a traffic light means:

options.text: Stop, then proceed when the way is clear.
Stop, then proceed when the light turns green or a green arrow appears.
You may turn in the direction the red arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then proceed when the light turns green or a green arrow appears.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must come to a complete stop and wait until a green light or green arrow appears, unless a sign says otherwise.

questions.question: Drinking coffee after drinking alcohol:

options.text: Does not change blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: Does not change blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not reduce blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it cannot make you sober.

questions.question: If an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is in your area, you should:

options.text: Clear a path for the emergency vehicle.
Signal when it is safe for them to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Clear a path for the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: Make every effort to give emergency vehicles a clear path. Pull to the side of the road if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: How can you avoid the risks of alcohol-related crashes?

options.text: Decide before you drink that you will not drive.
Say "No thanks, I'm driving" if someone offers you a drink.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do any of the above.
questions.explanation: To avoid drinking and driving, decide before you drink that you will not drive. Alcohol affects your judgment, making it harder to make safe decisions after you start drinking.

questions.question: What does a green arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is used only on one-way streets.
It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
You may proceed only if a circular green light also appears.
It points the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When can you turn right at a red traffic light?

options.text: After you stop completely behind the stop line.
After you yield to pedestrians and other vehicles.
Unless a sign says you cannot turn right on red.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Unless a sign says otherwise, you can turn right on red. You must stop completely at the stop line or crosswalk. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians before turning.

questions.question: What helps someone overcome the effects of alcohol?
questions.correctAnswerText: Only time
questions.explanation: Only time will reduce the effects of alcohol in your body.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle coming from the right.
The vehicle coming from the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle coming from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control, you must yield to a vehicle approaching from your right.

questions.question: When should you use parking lights?

options.text: Only when your vehicle is parked.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only when your vehicle is parked.
questions.explanation: Use parking lights only when your vehicle is parked.

questions.question: What is a sign of drunk driving?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Signs of drunk driving include weaving, driving too slow or too fast, jerking motions, and sudden stops.

questions.question: You are on a divided multilane highway and see or hear an emergency vehicle coming. What should you do?

options.text: Ignore the signal if other lanes are available for the emergency vehicle.
Slow down, move to give the emergency vehicle a clear path, and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move to give the emergency vehicle a clear path, and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights, slow down, provide a clear path, and stop. Do not try to outrun the emergency vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downhill grade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.
